payload.instruction: Move the mug to the right of the headphones

condition.question: Is the source mug visibly positioned to the right of the headphones in the edited image, or is there concrete visual evidence that this same mug moved toward that position?
condition.criteria: Compare source and edited images, tracking the source mug by its visible appearance, position, and plausible continuity through scene changes. Score only placement progress of the source mug relative to the headphones. Full fulfillment requires the source mug to be identifiable and visibly to the right of the headphones. Partial fulfillment requires concrete evidence supporting that the source mug itself moved toward the right, even if it has not reached a position to the right; weigh possible continuity against contradictory evidence such as a remnant at the original location, multiple candidate mugs, or substantial appearance changes. A candidate mug's location alone does not establish source identity or movement. If the evidence genuinely cannot support either movement or no movement, leave fulfillment unresolved rather than treating ambiguity as proof of no progress.
condition.binding: SOURCE: one large light-blue mug left of the headphones. EDITED: a blue blur remains at the former left location; a light-colored mug appears between that location and the headphones, and another appears to their right. The edited mugs are not visually established as the source mug, so their positions alone do not prove its movement. The headphones are also altered, which is unrelated to the requested mug placement.
condition.source_quote: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
condition.aspect: Relative position of the mug and headphones
condition.endpoint: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
condition.necessity: This relative placement is the requested edit, and the mug must be the source mug rather than a newly appearing or duplicate mug.
condition.zero_when: There is no concrete visual evidence supporting that the source mug moved toward the right of the headphones; a blur at its original location or a different mug appearing elsewhere, without supporting continuity, does not count as movement.
condition.half_when: Concrete visual evidence supports that the source mug itself moved toward the right of the headphones, but it has not yet reached a position to their right. Weigh appearance and positional continuity against remnants, multiple candidates, and scene changes; if the evidence genuinely cannot support either movement or no movement, use an unresolved score rather than partial credit or zero.
condition.full_when: The source mug is clearly identifiable in the edited image and is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
